falsifiers.setup: Build an exact completed heard result. Build a fully valid MemoryLifecycleState plus TypedMemoryRecord referenced by memory_event, but set the lifecycle payload_ref and payload_sha256 to a different internally valid payload.
falsifiers.failure_signature: A VoiceHeardResultReentryReceipt contains memory_evidence for the unrelated lifecycle state without an explicit unrelated-reference-only classification.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Separates memory-id/type validity from the missing causal payload relation identified by MEM01.

falsifiers.setup: Use an unrelated valid MemoryLifecycleState payload, but create a TypedMemoryRecord whose evidence refs include the heard-result payload_ref. memory_event still references the valid memory_id.
falsifiers.failure_signature: The consumer treats a typed-record evidence reference as proof that the lifecycle payload itself equals the heard result.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Prevents a superficial repair that checks only typed-memory refs/provenance instead of exact lifecycle payload_ref plus payload_sha256.

falsifiers.setup: Create a valid binding through bind_reentry_to_uptake(), then clone/replace it with the factory-origin marker removed while preserving the same public binding identity/status/downstream fields; bind an event whose gwt_ref matches the binding_id.
falsifiers.failure_signature: The consumer awards exact GWT reentry/uptake semantics merely because public binding fields and binding_id look valid.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Distinguishes actual existing-authority factory admission from a structurally identical reconstructed object.

falsifiers.setup: Directly construct a structurally valid GwtReentryUptakeBinding with uptake_status=UPTAKEN, plausible downstream_ref/downstream_sha256 and matching event.gwt_ref, but without admitted WP507/WP508 source objects or validation lineage.
falsifiers.failure_signature: Direct construction becomes evidence of actual uptake, causal influence, J-Space runtime, or completion.
falsifiers.why_high_information: Protects against Goodharting on receipt shape and positive-looking status fields.

acceptance_guidance: A robust G3 fix should make VSR07A/VSR07B fail closed for exact heard-result memory semantics and should make VSR08A/VSR08B either fail closed for exact GWT semantics or remain explicitly reference-only with all GWT/J-Space/causal promotion fields zero. Do not weaken an existing WP507/WP508 validator or invent a second GWT authority.
